'''Horn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] he was posted at the [[Proculus Station]] above [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where active under orders of [[Darth Tormen]] he assistsed a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] in capturing a Republic spacer [[Zale Barrows]]. Horn was promoted to a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] by the time of the [[Battle of Corellia]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Horn appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Belsavis.
